The closest I came to dying so far, was in Hawaii when I was about 9 years old.

I had family there, so I got to go stay with them that summer with my cousin who was near my age.

They took us to the locals beach on Maui, no lifeguards, and sent us out to play in the water. It was great! Body Surfing, wildlife etc. Then the riptide got me. I remember clearly swimming as hard as I could and going backwards out to see. Getting further and further away. I got very lucky and my foot touched a clump of rock (lava?) under the water, and I was able to push off of it and get out of the current. Very tired now, I struggled back to shore crying like a baby. Happy to be alive, but still very scared.

I'm still scared of really deep water to this day, though I will go in it, I have to will myself to do it.

I'm 45 now and still remember it well. Scary stuff.
